scope: New common simulation environment for all methods; no planner algorithm change; no ROS execution by this mapping.
actor_semantics: parameterized deterministic reactive actor; direct reuse of frozen advanceV3ReactiveActor, with route-projected first-crossing gate plus per-actor delay

start.usage: world XY initial position and straight trajectory origin

end.usage: world XY path endpoint; clamped scalar progress

conflict.usage: world XY actor projection and Euclidean ego distance for frozen reaction

base_speed_mps.usage: live nominal and initial internal speed; actor position remains fixed until gate delay elapsed

gate_delay_s.usage: simulation seconds after first route-projected gate observation; no absolute start_delay

response_seed.usage: recorded deterministic configuration only; frozen jitter multiplier is zero, no behavioral effect

nominal_arrival_difference_s.usage: offline input qualification proxy only; does not control live motion

radius_m.usage: legacy inscribed-radius metadata; exact box is collision geometry

initial_pose_xyz_rpy.usage: actual world XY/z.5/yaw follows transformed start-to-end direction

fixed_actor_values.gate_threshold_scope: exact projected actor trigger; episode warmup checks at policy_start_x-.030, so source-stamped gate time must be reported separately
fixed_actor_values.motion_model: legacy straight-path SetWorldPose; kinematic scripted actor, not force-driven walking dynamics

seed.usage: runner must pass to Gazebo --seed and robot dynamics_seed; scan gaussian noise stddev.01 uses Gazebo global RNG
seed.behavioral_variation: scan randomness expected; live seed binding/repeatability remains a runtime check

rng_substreams.actor_parameters.usage: offline live-bound policy/base speed/response distance/response margin/gate delay sampling

actor.response_seed.usage: passed to inherited deterministic config; zero jitter multiplier

rng_substreams.sensor_noise.usage: reserved future independent sensor stream; actual scan uses global Gazebo seed

rng_substreams.actuator.usage: reserved future independent actuator stream; actual dynamics_seed is episode seed, command_jitter0 disables random delay

rigid_transform_scope.actor_plugin: world path and ego route projection support arbitrary finite SE2
rigid_transform_scope.derived_executable_inputs: identity SE2 only until planner/map/evaluator live bridges are implemented
rigid_transform_scope.future_scene_transforms: transform actor/static geometry and robot spawn/goal together; planner observation and map frame bridge required; do not rotate body Twist scalar commands

actor_lifecycle_guards.initial_ego_spawn: allowed; actor fixed at start and simulation time anchored from Load
actor_lifecycle_guards.ego_disappearance_after_observation: permanent actor gate_fault, episode invalid; no later catch-up integration
actor_lifecycle_guards.reaction_enable_time: inherited absolute sim-time threshold, default0; only activation gate delay is newly relative
